How every block is ordered

  1. Private clinic firstOn the registry as a practice, not a hospital line.
  2. Owner, then doctors, then the officeT1 owner or president · T2 physicians · T3 office manager.
  3. One call per phone lineEveryone else at that number waits in the folder's HOLD file. Ask for them on the same call.
  4. Their own line firstA direct line beats a shared one, and a shared one beats the front desk.
  5. Then the smallest, and those with an email1 to 4 staff with no website first; an email lets you send the intro before you call.

Calling from Zoom Phone

  1. Sign in to Zoom on your computerThe Zoom desktop app, on your Zoom Phone line.
  2. Make Zoom your calling appWindows: Settings, Apps, Default apps, choose defaults by link type, then set TEL and CALLTO to Zoom.
  3. Open the copy saved on your computerThere, "Call on Zoom" dials the clinic from your line. Inside this shared page the call buttons may not open, so use Copy and paste the number into Zoom.
